LanguageData.UESDdebuger.SettingsHeader: Project configuration (MCP/config.json) and tool toggles (MCP/toolConfig.json). Closing this window saves; the MCP server needs to be restarted to take effect.
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ButtonShowAnnouncements: Show configuration announcements again (does not modify configuration)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolSectionHeader: Tool toggles (toolConfig.json tools) — uncheck to disable; agg_call_tool can still invoke disabled tools
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.DialogCopyButton: Copy selected IDE configuration to clipboard
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.DialogChangelogEmpty: (No update notes for the current version)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.agg_list_tools: Aggregation meta-tool: lists all tools with [enabled]/[disabled] status, including tools hidden by compressed mode
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.agg_call_tool: Aggregation meta-tool: invokes any tool directly by name — including tools disabled (unchecked) in this list; only agg_call_tool itself needs to be enabled
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.mcp_help: Query usage instructions for any tool (parameters/prerequisites/examples)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.start_game: Start RimWorld and wait for the main menu to be ready
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.get_game_status: Get game running status and stage
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.start_quick_test: Trigger quick-test map load and wait for map loading to complete
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.inspect_type: [UE] Open a specified type in the UE inspector
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.get_unityexplorer_s: [UE] Get UE UI and panel readiness status
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.get_unityexplorer_l: [UE] Read the UE log panel content
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.create_hook: [UE] Create a method hook to intercept calls and view parameters/return values
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.toggle_hook: [UE] Enable or disable a created hook
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.execute_csharp_code: [UE] Execute code in the UE C# console
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.reset_csharp_consol: [UE] Reset the UE C# console state
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.add_using_directive: [UE] Add a using directive to the C# console
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.post_camera_change_: [RIMAPI] Move the game camera to specified coordinates
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.post_stream_start: [RIMAPI] Start the camera video stream; with output_frames=true captures frames from the stream to JPEG sequence in out_dir
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.post_stream_stop: [RIMAPI] Stop the camera video stream (auto-stops frame capture if output_frames was enabled)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.get_colonists_detai: [RIMAPI] Get detailed information for all colonists
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.get_colonist_detail: [RIMAPI] Get detailed information for a single colonist
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.post_select: [RIMAPI] Select an object in the game
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.post_ui_message: [RIMAPI] Show a message notification in the game
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.post_ui_dialog: [RIMAPI] Show a dialog in the game
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.post_map_marker: [Map] Place a coordinate cursor on the map (hellsphere-cannon style, colour configurable, left-click to dismiss)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.attach: [Debug] Connect to RimWorld's mono debug port
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.reconnect: [Debug] Reconnect the debug session (auto rediscovers the port)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.launch: [Debug] Start the game in debug mode and auto-attach
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.break_add: [Debug] Set a breakpoint at a specified method
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.break_list: [Debug] List all breakpoints in the current session
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.break_exception: [Debug] Create an exception breakpoint (by exception type/catch state)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.wait: [Debug] Wait for a matching debug event (breakpoint/step/exception)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.callstack: [Debug] Get the call stack of a specified thread
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.inspect: [Debug] Expand object fields (child objects return handles)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.eval: [Debug] Evaluate an expression inside the game process
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.find_methods: [Debug] Search methods by method name substring
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.compile_l: [RimBridgeServer] Compile the supported lowered Lua subset, not general-purpose Lua, into the JSON script model without executing capability calls; use this first for new script shapes
[RimBridgeServer] Load a .lua file and compile it as the same lowered Lua subset used by rimbridge/run_lua without executing capability calls
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.get_bridg: [RimBridgeServer] Get the current bridge and RimWorld state snapshot without mutating game state
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.get_capab: [RimBridgeServer] Get one registered bridge capability descriptor by capability id or alias
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.get_lua_r: [RimBridgeServer] Get a machine-readable authoring reference for the lowered rimbridge/run_lua subset, including quick-start rules, common pitfalls, params binding, compile errors, limits, and examples
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.get_opera: [RimBridgeServer] Get the latest retained journal snapshot for a specific operation id, including any bounded retained result payload
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.get_scrip: [RimBridgeServer] Get a machine-readable authoring reference for rimbridge/run_script, including statement types, expressions, conditions, limits, and examples
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.list_capa: [RimBridgeServer] List registered bridge capabilities so an agent can discover the live bridge surface instead of relying on hardcoded tool knowledge
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.list_logs: [RimBridgeServer] List recent captured RimWorld and bridge log entries from the in-memory log journal, including operation correlation when available
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.list_oper: [RimBridgeServer] List recent bridge operation lifecycle events from the in-memory event journal
[RimBridgeServer] List recent bridge operations from the in-memory operation journal, optionally expanding retained result payloads
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.run_lua: [RimBridgeServer] Compile a small lowered Lua subset, not general-purpose Lua, into the shared script runner and execute it through the normal capability registry; start with rimbridge/get_lua_reference or rimbridge/compile_lua
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.run_lua_f: [RimBridgeServer] Load a .lua file, treat it as the same lowered Lua subset used by rimbridge/run_lua, and execute it through the shared script runner
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.run_scrip: [RimBridgeServer] Execute a JSON script containing ordered capability calls and generic control statements; call rimbridge/get_script_reference for the machine-readable language reference
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimbridge.wait_for_: [RimBridgeServer] Wait until RimWorld reaches the requested loaded-game readiness level
[RimBridgeServer] Wait until RimWorld reports no long events in progress
[RimBridgeServer] Wait for an operation in the journal to reach a terminal status
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.activate_a: [RimBridgeServer] Activate one alert by alert id returned from rimworld/list_alerts, mirroring a normal left-click on the alert readout
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.apply_arch: [RimBridgeServer] Apply an Architect designator to one cell or a rectangle, with optional dry-run validation
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.clear_area: [RimBridgeServer] Clear all cells from a mutable area such as a custom allowed area
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.clear_hove: [RimBridgeServer] Clear the current virtual cursor/hover target so screenshots, mouseover-driven UI, and map clicks return to the real cursor state
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.click_cell: [RimBridgeServer] Dispatch a live map click at a current-map cell without requiring OS focus, using left, right, or middle mouse button and reporting before/after selection
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.click_scre: [RimBridgeServer] Semantically click a known actionable target id returned by rimworld/get_screen_targets without requiring OS focus
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.click_ui_t: [RimBridgeServer] Activate an actionable UI control target returned by rimworld/get_ui_layout on the next real draw frame
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.close_cont: [RimBridgeServer] Close the currently opened debug context menu
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.close_main: [RimBridgeServer] Close the currently open RimWorld main tab, optionally asserting which tab is open first
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.close_wind: [RimBridgeServer] Close an open RimWorld window by type name or, if omitted, the topmost window
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.create_all: [RimBridgeServer] Create a new allowed area and optionally make it the selected allowed-area target
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.delete_are: [RimBridgeServer] Delete a mutable area such as a custom allowed area
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.delete_zon: [RimBridgeServer] Delete an existing zone by id
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.deselect_p: [RimBridgeServer] Deselect a single selected pawn by name or stable pawn id
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.dismiss_le: [RimBridgeServer] Dismiss a specific dismissible letter by native letter id, mirroring a normal right-click on the letter stack entry
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.dpa_cleanu: [RimBridgeServer] Request Dubs Performance Analyzer cleanup after a profiling run
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.dpa_patch_: [RimBridgeServer] Patch explicit methods or a built-in preset into Dubs Performance Analyzer for repeatable Tick or Update profiling
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.dpa_reset: [RimBridgeServer] Reset Dubs Performance Analyzer profiler buffers without changing the active patch set
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.dpa_snapsh: [RimBridgeServer] Snapshot current Dubs Performance Analyzer profiler rows sorted by average, max, total, calls, calls per entry, or label
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.dpa_status: [RimBridgeServer] Read Dubs Performance Analyzer availability and bridge integration state without mutating DPA
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.dpa_stop: [RimBridgeServer] Stop Dubs Performance Analyzer profiling and reset its UI state without running cleanup
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.drag_cell: [RimBridgeServer] Dispatch a literal live map mouse drag from one current-map cell to another without requiring OS focus, publishing mouse position plus held/down/up button state so vanilla and modded input handlers see the gesture. Left drag can select, right drag can drive drafted formation targets, and middle drag can pan the camera.
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.execute_co: [RimBridgeServer] Execute a context menu option by index or label
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.execute_gi: [RimBridgeServer] Execute one grouped gizmo for the current selection by gizmo id returned from rimworld/list_selected_gizmos
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.find_rando: [RimBridgeServer] Use RimWorld's expanding-radius random cell search to find a nearby cell or footprint that satisfies generic map criteria
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.flood_fill: [RimBridgeServer] Analyze a contiguous area from one root cell using RimWorld's generic cell flood-fill algorithm and the same reusable footprint criteria as find_random_cell_near
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.frame_cell: [RimBridgeServer] Frame a requested map-cell rectangle plus optional margin cells at the current camera zoom, or at an explicit root size when provided
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.frame_pawn: [RimBridgeServer] Frame a comma-separated list of pawns by name and/or stable pawn id so they fit in view
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_camera: [RimBridgeServer] Get the current map camera position, zoom, configured size range, extension opt-in state, and visible rect
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_cell_i: [RimBridgeServer] Inspect one map cell, including things, blueprints, frames, designations, zones, and areas
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_cells_: [RimBridgeServer] Inspect every map cell in a rectangle up to 1024 cells, including things, blueprints, frames, designations, zones, and areas
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_contex: [RimBridgeServer] Get the currently opened debug context menu options
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_debug_: [RimBridgeServer] Get metadata for one RimWorld debug action path and, optionally, its immediate children
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_design: [RimBridgeServer] Get the current Architect/designator selection state, including god mode and the selected designator
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_game_i: [RimBridgeServer] Get basic information about the current RimWorld game
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_map_ta: [RimBridgeServer] Resolve a current-map pawn or thing to its map position and occupied cell rectangle
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_mod_co: [RimBridgeServer] Read semantic mod-configuration status for the current active load order, including warnings, ordering issues, and whether a restart is required to match the loaded session
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_mod_se: [RimBridgeServer] Read one loaded mod's semantic ModSettings object by stable mod id, package id, settings category, or handle type name
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_screen: [RimBridgeServer] Get current screen-space targets such as open windows and active context-menu geometry
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_select: [RimBridgeServer] Read the selected pawn's carried thing and inventory contents, including Pick Up And Haul tracked items when available
[RimBridgeServer] Get structured details for the current selection, including inspect strings, inspect-tab types, and the current selection fingerprint
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_ui_lay: [RimBridgeServer] Capture a generic structured layout snapshot of the current dialogs, windows, main tabs, dynamic inspect tab strip, or selected gizmo grid, including actionable controls, crop-ready screen rects, and scroll-view metadata
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.get_ui_sta: [RimBridgeServer] Get the current RimWorld window stack and input state for background-safe UI automation
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.go_to_main: [RimBridgeServer] Return to the RimWorld main menu entry scene, or no-op if already there
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.jump_camer: [RimBridgeServer] Jump the camera to a map cell
[RimBridgeServer] Jump the camera to a pawn by name or stable pawn id
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_alert: [RimBridgeServer] List active RimWorld alerts with structured culprit targets and alert-snapshot-scoped alert ids
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_archi: [RimBridgeServer] List RimWorld Architect categories using stable category ids
[RimBridgeServer] List Architect designators for one category, flattening dropdown widgets into actionable child designators
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_areas: [RimBridgeServer] List current-map areas such as home, roof, snow-clear, and allowed areas
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_colon: [RimBridgeServer] List player-controlled colonists available for selection and drafting, including stable pawn ids
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_debug: [RimBridgeServer] List direct children of a RimWorld debug action path
[RimBridgeServer] List top-level RimWorld debug action roots using stable internal debug-action paths
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_inspe: [RimBridgeServer] List the current selection's dynamic RimWorld inspect tabs such as Health, Needs, Gear, and mod-provided tabs with stable selection-scoped inspect-tab ids
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_langu: [RimBridgeServer] List installed RimWorld languages, including a recommended ASCII-safe switch query for each language and the currently active language
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_lette: [RimBridgeServer] List current letter-stack entries with native letter ids, semantic letter content, and structured look-target metadata
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_main_: [RimBridgeServer] List RimWorld main tabs such as Work, Assign, Research, and mod-provided tabs with stable main-tab target ids
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_messa: [RimBridgeServer] List live RimWorld messages with native message ids and structured look-target metadata
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_mod_s: [RimBridgeServer] List loaded mod handles that expose a settings dialog, a persistent ModSettings state object, or both
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_mods: [RimBridgeServer] List installed RimWorld mods, whether each one is enabled in the current configuration, and whether it matches the currently loaded session
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_saves: [RimBridgeServer] List saved RimWorld games with mod-compatibility details and optionally return only saves whose recorded mods are all currently active
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_selec: [RimBridgeServer] List the current selection's actionable grouped gizmos using deterministic selection-scoped gizmo ids
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.list_zones: [RimBridgeServer] List current-map zones such as stockpiles and growing zones
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.load_game: [RimBridgeServer] Load a named RimWorld save after verifying every recorded mod is active unless ignoreModCompatibility is true
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.load_game_: [RimBridgeServer] Load a named RimWorld save after verifying every recorded mod is active unless ignoreModCompatibility is true, then wait until the requested readiness level
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.move_camer: [RimBridgeServer] Move the camera by a cell offset
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.open_conte: [RimBridgeServer] Dispatch a live map click at a target pawn or cell and capture the resulting context menu when one remains open
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.open_inspe: [RimBridgeServer] Open one current RimWorld inspect tab by inspect-tab id, translated label, label key, tutor tag, or .NET type name
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.open_lette: [RimBridgeServer] Open a specific letter by native letter id, mirroring a normal left-click on the letter stack entry
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.open_main_: [RimBridgeServer] Open one RimWorld main tab by stable target id, defName, label, or tab window type
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.open_mod_s: [RimBridgeServer] Open RimWorld's native Dialog_ModSettings window for one loaded mod without foreground-dependent input
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.open_windo: [RimBridgeServer] Open a RimWorld window by short or full .NET type name when the window exposes a public parameterless constructor
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.play_for: [RimBridgeServer] Unpause the current game at a requested time speed for a bounded real-time duration, then pause it again; speed 4 (Ultrafast) is boosted by default, and forced-normal-speed slowdown can optionally be suppressed during the run
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.play_until: [RimBridgeServer] Unpause the current game at a requested time speed until a new right-side letter appears, then pause and return the new letter payload; speed 4 (Ultrafast) is boosted by default, and forced-normal-speed slowdown can optionally be suppressed during the run
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.press_acce: [RimBridgeServer] Send semantic accept input to the active RimWorld window stack without requiring OS focus
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.press_canc: [RimBridgeServer] Send semantic cancel input to the active RimWorld window stack without requiring OS focus
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.reload_mod: [RimBridgeServer] Reload a loaded mod's ModSettings object from disk, discarding unsaved in-memory changes
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.reorder_mo: [RimBridgeServer] Move one currently enabled mod to a new zero-based active load-order index, optionally persisting the updated ModsConfig.xml immediately
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.right_clic: [RimBridgeServer] Dispatch a live map click interaction for the current pawn selection so vanilla and modded handlers see the same input path as a real click
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.save_game: [RimBridgeServer] Save the current game to a named save
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.screenshot: [RimBridgeServer] Center a requested map-cell rectangle plus optional margin cells at the current camera zoom, capture it, crop to the cell bounds, and restore the prior camera immediately after by default
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.scroll_ui_: [RimBridgeServer] Scroll a scroll_view ui-element target returned by rimworld/get_ui_layout on the next real draw frame
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.select_all: [RimBridgeServer] Select an allowed area by id for area-designator flows, or clear the selection when areaId is omitted
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.select_arc: [RimBridgeServer] Select an Architect designator by stable id without relying on foreground UI interaction
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.select_paw: [RimBridgeServer] Select a single colonist by name or stable pawn id
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_camera: [RimBridgeServer] Set the current camera root size directly
[RimBridgeServer] Enable or disable RimBridgeServer's session-only extended camera zoom range; disabled by default
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_coloni: [RimBridgeServer] Deterministically enable or disable job-tracker logging for one current-map colonist and return a log cursor plus recommended rimbridge/list_logs arguments for consuming future job lines
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_debug_: [RimBridgeServer] Set a RimWorld debug setting toggle by stable path to a deterministic on/off state
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_draft: [RimBridgeServer] Draft or undraft a colonist by name or stable pawn id
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_god_mo: [RimBridgeServer] Enable or disable RimWorld god mode deterministically
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_hover_: [RimBridgeServer] Set a bounded virtual cursor/hover target for UI review and screenshots, using a ui-element or screen target id, explicit screen coordinates, or a current-map cell, pawn, or thing
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_mod_en: [RimBridgeServer] Enable or disable one installed mod by stable mod id, package id, name, or folder name, optionally persisting the updated ModsConfig.xml immediately
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_time_s: [RimBridgeServer] Set RimWorld's current time speed directly; RimBridgeServer enables the boost for speed 4 (Ultrafast) at startup, and this tool can change that state
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.set_zone_t: [RimBridgeServer] Set or clear the explicit existing-zone target on a zone-add designator
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.spawn_thin: [RimBridgeServer] Spawn a thing on the current map at a target cell
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.start_debu: [RimBridgeServer] Start RimWorld's built-in quick test colony from the main menu while honoring RimWorld's Pause on load preference
[RimBridgeServer] Start RimWorld's built-in quick test colony from the main menu, honor RimWorld's Pause on load preference, and wait for the requested readiness level
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.step_game_: [RimBridgeServer] Advance the paused game by an exact number of ticks, one tick per Unity update frame, mirroring RimWorld's Dev_TickOnce path while preserving render-frame boundaries
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.switch_lan: [RimBridgeServer] Switch RimWorld to an installed language by the recommendedQuery from rimworld/list_languages or another exact language name match, mirroring the main-menu language picker and saving prefs
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.take_scree: [RimBridgeServer] Take an in-game screenshot and optionally crop it to a screen target, UI surface, UI element, or scroll-view region
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.update_mod: [RimBridgeServer] Apply one or more field-path updates to a loaded mod's ModSettings object, with optional immediate persistence through Mod.WriteSettings()
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.rimworld.zoom_camer: [RimBridgeServer] Adjust the current camera zoom/root size
